topic: (b) what the Theta-link is, and whether it may identify the two real lines
claim_A: the Theta-link ... is the (full poly-)isomorphism between the F-prime-strips ... However, the Theta-link forgets about the concrete embeddings ...; in order for a meaningful inequality to be concluded, one must consistently identify all of these [copies of R]

source_B: Mochizuki, IUT III, introduction p.1 and Remark 3.11.1(ii)

what_would_settle_it: a typed statement of source/target category of the Theta-link plus a proof that it induces no identification of value-group lines; or a derivation of the critic's identification from III Definition 3.8
